title: Multimodality STRAUS simulated ultrasound and material motion
version_note: BR-029 integrity review dated 2026-09-16 verifies retained patient01_healthy image/mesh and patient04_lbbb mesh manifests. BR-035 reuses the audited 30-frame healthy simulation; exact task transformations remain experiment-specific.
terms_note: Public Girder access was recorded in the September 2026 source review, but public downloading did not establish redistribution permission. Source assets were kept local; no current license determination is added.
reference_note: Simulator meshes have persistent topology and material identities, unlike clinical image-derived contours. Directional strain excludes elements without valid source directions. Synthetic truth is not measured patient strain; matching masks alone does not uniquely determine material motion.
access_note: Healthy ultrasound and meshes and the separate LBBB mesh sequence were retained and hash-verified in BR-029. The BR-025 inventory-only note predates those acquisitions and remains historical.
